title: 9 Best AI Receptionists for Vacation Rentals in 2026
summary: 9 AI receptionists for vacation rental managers, compared on lockouts, PMS bookings, on-call handoff, languages and published prices.
body_markdown:
Vacation rental AI receptionists split into PMS-connected agents, rental tools that answer and route without a live reservation lookup, and general business receptionists. Pick Akia or Conduit if the agent should change something on the call (a booking with payment on Akia, a new door code or PMS edit on Conduit), Besty or SendSquared if the agent should see the reservation and hand off to your team, and one of the others for routing, messages and the on-call handoff.


## What calls does an AI receptionist need to handle for a vacation rental?


An AI receptionist for a vacation rental handles five call types: lockouts, maintenance emergencies, in-stay questions, bookings or changes, and owner calls. A call counts as handled when the caller hangs up with the problem fixed or with the right person already working on it.


- A lockout is handled when the agent verifies the guest against the reservation, sends or regenerates the door code, and rings the on-call person if the lock still fails.
- For a maintenance emergency, the agent separates an urgent problem from a routine one, logs the work order and reaches whoever is on call.
- An in-stay question about WiFi, parking or checkout time gets answered from that property's own details.
- A booking or date change ends with the reservation updated in the PMS, or with the caller warm-transferred to someone who can update it.
- An owner call reaches a person on your team, with a summary of what the owner wanted.


## How did we order this list?


The order of this list comes from what each tool's phone page says it reads and changes in your PMS mid-call, using vendor pages reviewed November 26, 2026. Group one reads the live reservation during the call, and tools that change something on the call (a booking with payment, a PMS write-back or a new access code) come first. Group two is rental-focused tools whose phone pages describe no live reservation lookup, and group three is general business receptionists. Ties are alphabetical, and Conduit, our product, sits where the rule puts it.


## Which AI receptionists read the reservation during the call?


Four AI receptionists on this list read the live reservation during the call. Akia and Conduit come first because their pages describe changing something on the call (a booking and payment for Akia, a PMS write-back or new access code for Conduit), followed alphabetically by Besty and SendSquared, which see the reservation and route or transfer.


### 1. Akia


[Akia](https://www.akia.com/agents/voice) answers every call at any hour on the first ring and matches callers to PMS reservations. Its voice page names Mews, Cloudbeds, StayNTouch, Guesty and Hostaway. Akia takes bookings, texts a PCI-compliant payment link mid-call and stays on the line until the payment clears, and warm-transfers with a summary. AI Voice sits in Akia's Max tier and suits managers already on Akia for messaging who want the phone on the same agent.


### 2. Conduit


[Conduit](https://www.conduit.ai/pricing) answers calls 24/7 or on a schedule and writes back to connected PMSs; its[VoiceAI docs](https://docs.conduit.ai/setup/channels/connect-voiceai-ai-number) list the supported call languages, and messaging covers 140+ languages. On a lockout it generates a new access code from the PMS during the call, and it dispatches maintenance and hands off through static, dynamic or warm transfers. Messaging starts at $18 per unit per month with voice included, with volume pricing past 50 units, and the Startup plan is $899 a month for up to 25 units with every Full Suite feature. Conduit: best for vacation rental managers who want calls and messages on one agent because Haven Vacation Rentals runs at 90% automation on Conduit. A manager who only wants an after-hours message-taker is buying more than they need.


### 3. Besty


[Besty](https://www.getbesty.ai/software-rolodex) answers and routes calls 24/7 with the reservation open and escalates urgent requests. One number per account carries SMS and guest and owner calls, with transcripts and summaries in each thread. Besty prices as a single revenue share with a $500,000 minimum in annual guest revenue, and the fee covers software plus an operations team that offers 24/7 guest support with 5-minute replies.


### 4. SendSquared


[SendSquared](https://sendsquared.com/solutions/ai-voice-for-vacation-rentals/) answers 24/7 in 30+ languages from live PMS data. It checks availability across the portfolio and warm-transfers callers who are ready to book, so your reservation team closes the sale, and flagged owner and VIP numbers skip the AI. Calls share a guest record with SMS, WhatsApp, Airbnb and email, across 12 named PMSs including Streamline, Escapia, Guesty and Hostaway.


## Which AI receptionists answer and route calls without a live reservation lookup?


Ody and ProhostAI are rental-focused AI receptionists that answer routine calls and pass urgent ones to a person you name, and neither phone page describes reading or editing the live reservation during the call. Both let you choose when the AI picks up, and both log the call where your team already works.


### 5. Ody


[Ody](https://ody.co/industries/hotels-vacation-rentals) bundles a business line and an AI receptionist from $19 per user per month ($15 on the annual Starter plan). You set whether the desk or the AI answers first, and the AI answers from property notes you write. For a lockout, Ody checks the name on the booking and texts the current code again, then rings your on-call list if the guest still cannot get in. It shares your booking link for availability calls and pushes requests to Guesty, Hostaway, Cloudbeds or Mews via Make, webhooks or its API, since it has no native PMS connection yet.


### 6. ProhostAI


[ProhostAI](https://www.prohost.ai/ai-phone) answers missed calls, after-hours calls, unknown callers, or every call if you set it to. Its main platform connects to PMSs including Hostaway, Guesty and OwnerRez, and the phone routes each call to the guest's conversation when it can match the caller. When a call needs a person, ProhostAI transfers it to your chosen number and attaches the recording, transcript and summary to that thread. AI Phone is an add-on from $30 a month (about 200 minutes of talk time) next to platform plans at $10 or $15 per property per month.


## Which general AI receptionists work for rental managers?


Three general business AI receptionists fit rental managers who mainly need the phone answered and urgent calls routed. RingCentral AI Receptionist, Smith.ai and VirtualPBX are built for any service business, and none of their product pages publishes a vacation rental PMS connection.


### 7. RingCentral AI Receptionist


[RingCentral AI Receptionist](https://www.ringcentral.com/ai-receptionist.html) starts at $39 a month, standalone or as an add-on, and learns from your website, FAQs or uploaded documents. It can run 24/7 or on a schedule you set, answers texts as well as calls, and books appointments through connected calendars. Callers who need a person get routed to your team with a summary, and the agent works in 10+ languages, switching when the caller does.


### 8. Smith.ai


[Smith.ai](https://smith.ai/pricing/ai-receptionist) answers calls 24/7 with AI first and can transfer complex calls to live North America-based receptionists day or night. Its free plan covers 25 calls per month, and Pro starts at $150 per month for 75 calls ($2.00 per call). Smith.ai works in English and Spanish and connects to Zapier. It fits teams that want a person behind the AI at any hour.


### 9. VirtualPBX


[VirtualPBX](https://www.virtualpbx.com/ai/receptionist/) packages an AI Employee with business phone service for up to 5 people at $99 per month, with a 14-day trial. It covers after hours, weekends, holidays and busy stretches. On after-hours calls the AI Employee takes messages on routine requests and puts emergencies through to your on-call schedule.

## What does an AI receptionist cost for a vacation rental?


Vacation rental AI receptionist pricing comes in six models: per unit or property, per user, a flat monthly fee, call bundles, a share of revenue, and quotes on request. Per-user and flat plans start lowest (Ody at $15 per user on annual billing, RingCentral at $39 a month, VirtualPBX at $99 for up to 5 people), while per-unit plans grow with the portfolio.


For a 40-unit manager, Conduit Messaging starts at $720 a month (40 × $18), with volume pricing past 50 units. ProhostAI's All-in-one plan plus the entry AI Phone add-on starts at $630 (40 × $15, plus $30), and AI Phone usage also draws on ProhostAI's AI credits. Smith.ai Pro stays at $150 for 75 calls whatever the unit count, with each extra call at $2.50. Up to 25 units, Conduit's Startup plan is a flat $899 a month with every Full Suite feature, against $18 per unit for Messaging alone.


## What should you ask in an AI receptionist demo?


Testing an AI receptionist takes five demo calls that match your overnight and Sunday traffic. Bring a test booking in your PMS, an owner's phone number and a script in a second language, then check the PMS record and the transfer log after each call.


- Call as an 11pm lockout and check whether the agent finds the booking and delivers the code.
- Ask to move checkout or book a night, then check your PMS for edits or warm transfers.
- Call from an owner number to test guest-script bypass or owner-thread logging.
- Run a Spanish or other non-English call to test conversation quality and mid-call switching.
- Trigger an emergency while your first on-call number ignores the ring to verify backup escalation.


Our[guide to voice AI for vacation rentals](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/voice-ai-for-vacation-rentals-property-management-complete-guide) covers how voice agents connect to a PMS, and the[vacation rental answering service](https://www.conduit.ai/industry/short-term-rentals/answering-service) page walks through Conduit's lockout flow. If you are still choosing the phone line itself, the[vacation rental phone systems](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/vacation-rental-phone-systems) comparison covers business telephony.


## FAQ


Rental managers shortlisting an AI receptionist usually ask about lockouts, bookings, owner calls and languages, and two names that come up in searches for this category, Ruby and HostBuddy AI, are not on the list. The answers below cover both groups of questions in a sentence or two each.


### Can an AI receptionist handle a lockout at 2am?


An AI receptionist can fix a 2am lockout when it can find the caller's booking and get a working door code to them. Conduit describes generating a new code from the PMS on the call, and Ody re-texts the stored code and rings your on-call person if the lock still fails.


### Can an AI receptionist book a vacation rental?


Some AI receptionists take the booking on the call and others check availability and transfer to staff. Akia's page describes booking and payment on the same call, and SendSquared hands booking-ready callers to your reservation team.


### Do owners have to talk to the AI?


Owners do not have to talk to the AI on SendSquared, where a per-contact flag sends owner calls straight to your team. Besty puts owner call transcripts and summaries in the owner's own thread.


### How many languages do AI receptionists speak?


Published voice language counts run from English and Spanish on Smith.ai to 10+ on RingCentral and 30+ on SendSquared. Conduit lists its voice languages in its VoiceAI docs, and the other vendors here publish no count, so test your guests' languages in the demo.


### Is Ruby an AI receptionist?


Ruby is a live human receptionist service with optional AI enhancements, according to its pricing page, so it is not ranked here.


### Does HostBuddy AI answer phone calls?


HostBuddy AI does not publish a phone answering product; its homepage and pricing page describe AI guest messaging through your PMS.
